new_material_candidates.name: Grounded Test-Time Adaptation / Test-Time Adaptation for LLM Agents via Environment Interaction
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Peer-reviewed deployment-time adaptation for LLM agents using environment interaction, with distinct syntactic-alignment and dynamics-grounding mechanisms and official WebArena/BFCLv3/Tau-Bench implementation paths.

new_material_candidates.name: PFT3A
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Directly targets tabular label and feature shift while prohibiting source-data and source-prior access, making it materially distinct from FTAT, AdapTable and feature-decrement-specific methods already preserved.

new_material_candidates.name: Ramen
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Handles mixed-domain test streams through per-sample retrieval, domain-consistent active sample selection, prediction balancing and an embedding-gradient cache.

screened_not_promoted.name: Test-Time Perturbation Tuning with Delayed Feedback for Vision-Language-Action Models
screened_not_promoted.reason: The governed comparator pool has not established a matched vision-language-action robotics/control experiment, so a VLA-specific adaptation method must not be forced into generic E1 or E3 roles.

screened_not_promoted.name: Understanding Task Transfer in Vision-Language Models
screened_not_promoted.reason: Studies transfer among vision-language perception tasks and does not provide a common learned decision-transfer comparator across E1, E2 and E3.

screened_not_promoted.name: TTP adversarial VLM test-time adaptation
screened_not_promoted.reason: Adversarial robustness is a materially narrower evaluation contract than the generic E3 adaptation role and is only applicable if such a protected adversarial experiment is declared.

stopping_rule.reason: This balanced saturation round produced one new peer-reviewed materially relevant comparator in each of E1, E2, and E3.
